title: Bonus — Für Elise, Canon in D, Twinkle Twinkle
composer: Ludwig van Beethoven; Johann Pachelbel; Traditional French melody

attribution.title: Für Elise, WoO 59
attribution.changes: Complete familiar opening form A A B-A B-A: the two written repeats are observed. The final alternative closes on A minor instead of leading into the next piano episode.

attribution.title: Canon per 3 Violini e Basso
attribution.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for the consulted transcription
attribution.changes: First 16 bars of the original violin melody (original full-score bars 3–18), spanning eight complete ground-bass cycles: descending theme, eighth-note development, sixteenth-note development, and broader final variation; followed by an added D-major cadence.

attribution.title: Ah! vous dirai-je, maman / Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
attribution.credit: Traditional French tune; independently entered melody and new music-box harmonization
attribution.changes: Complete familiar tune twice, second statement one octave higher, with new broken-chord accompaniment and C-major close.
